Name: Modern Buildings Mill Silo Well Content Patcher Pack All-in-One
Author: monteso
Description:
A combine all-in-one Content Patcher pack  of each of my three modern farm buildings series, Wind mill, Steel silo, and Well. Includes config file for selecting the various wind mill color alts and togglable silo well. Select what you want. Requires Content Patcher and the latest Smapi. Compatible for the upcoming 1.3 update.

Check out the non Content Patcher verisons Modern Farm buildings series.
Silo   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/207]http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/207/?[/url]
Well  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/555]http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/555/?[/url]
[b]Mill  ﻿﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/585?tab=description]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/585?tab=description[/url]
[/b]
[u]Install info Content Patcher pack only
[/u]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download mod pack  and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Open config file. Toggle building options. Select preferred mill variant: Blue, Green, Red, Redalt[/*]

[/list]
